course_name_original: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning/Web Technologies (INF-37)
course_name_en: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning/Web Technologies
prerequisites: ARTIFICIAL NTELLIGENCE: A good knowledge of mathematical analysis and geometry is required. In addition, concepts from the statistics course will be used.
WEB TECHNOLOGIES: Basic knowledge of database, SQL language, Java and Python is appreciated.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the knowledge of software application development in any field, knowing how to integrate the knowledge of web technologies and the basic methods of artificial intelligence.
Provide knowledge and skills on the main machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques for the analysis of numerical data.
Provide an introduction to the basic tools for solving machine learning problems both supervised and unsupervised.
Provide knowledge and skills on methodologies and technologies for the design and development of modern applications based on Web and mobile infrastructures.
Know and understand the main pattern recognition and machine learning techniques for the analysis of heterogeneous data.

Know how to apply the main data classification algorithms, time sequences of information and complex patterns such as images and know how to apply the main techniques of supervised and unsupervised machine learning.

Autonomy of judgment in analyzing and designing complex systems, evaluating the impact of IT solutions in the application context, both in relation to the technical and organizational aspects and demonstrating to actively participate in the decision-making process in even interdisciplinary contexts.
Describe information, ideas, problems and solutions as well as technical aspects to heterogeneous interlocutors in a clear and understandable way.
Ability to recognize the need for autonomous learning throughout the life span, given the high rate of technological and methodological innovation in the area of Computer Engineering.
Ability to independently acquire new specialist knowledge from literature.

Know the most important technologies used in the World Wide Web, be able to write documents and Web and mobile applications, to take care of their visual appearance, to verify their correctness and universality, and to design and verify them usability and user experience.
Orientate within web and mobile technologies by recognizing and comparing the functionality of different languages / systems / architectures.
Describe the steps to be taken to model, develop and evaluate web and mobile applications.
Apply advanced techniques to verify usability and user experience.
Carry out a detailed analysis of the requirements of an application and suggest the most suitable technologies to implement the application.
Master the languages and software tools used during teaching and the exam.
Verify their degree of learning and understanding of the concepts exposed thanks to the possibility of intervening in class and the possibility represented by the individual essay.
Reorganize the knowledge learned and implement one's own capacity for critical and autonomous evaluation of what has been learned.
Evaluate advanced IT solutions in the field of web and mobile applications.
Express their knowledge correctly and logically, recognizing the required topic and responding in a timely and complete manner to the oral exam questions.

Summarize and fully process the research and developments conducted within the thesis, illustrating the key concepts and elements of distinction of their individual work with respect to the state of the art.
Master an accurate and proper terminology of information engineering.
Deepen the notions learned in order to independently provide for one's own updating, which is particularly crucial in a field of web and mobile development where technologies are constantly evolving.
Master and refine one's scientific and technical language.

syllabus_topics: Methods of clustering and unsupervised learning
Web Fundamentals & Architectures: Historical overview, protocols (URI, HTTP, HTTP/2), multi-tier system design, mashup architectures, and event-driven development
Frontend Development: Client-side design and programming using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, and React, with an introduction to mobile device sensor integration
Backend Development & Services: Server-side programming using Python (Flask), focused on building and consuming RESTful interfaces and services
Version Control & Project Management (Git): Code tracking, collaborative workflow management (branching, merging, pull requests)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam with closed questions on course content and formal aspects (Artificial Intelligence)
Programming test on exercises presented in class (Artificial Intelligence)
Written exam with open-ended and multiple-choice questions, and practical exercises (Web Technologies)
Individual project with presentation and discussion (Web Technologies)

assessment_rules: The overall grade for the integrated course will be the weighted average of the grades of the individual modules, rounded up. A grade of 30 cum Laude equals 30 for the calculation of the average. The final cum Laude honors for the integrated course will be awarded exclusively if the student achieves 30 in both modules, with cum Laude in at least one of the two (AI and Web Technologies). For Web Technologies, the written exam is graded on a scale from 0 to 23 points and the project is graded from 0 to 10 points.
bibliography: Slides and material provided by the teachers during the lessons
